prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production-quality V3 game battle SD sprite, a single full-body character on a genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Image 1 is the USER-APPROVED ORIGINAL CHARACTER and is the authoritative identity, face, complexion, hairstyle, clothing, colors, armor and weapon design. Preserve these faithfully. Image 2 is ONLY the existing project's SD quality reference: clean expressive line work, polished cel shading, readable compact anatomy and crisp materials. NEVER copy its face, gender, cat ears, hair, outfit or weapon.
Convert the adult character in image 1 into a handsome/expressive stylized super-deformed battle actor, approximately 3.5 heads tall, not a toddler, preserving age, ethnicity, body build and facial structure. Complete the full standing body from head to both boots; do not crop the source portrait or simply cut out the illustration. Camera is a restrained slightly elevated three-quarter game view, oriented slightly toward screen LEFT, face visible. Natural proportions within the SD design, never horizontally compressed. Keep all character details specific to image 1.
One coherent ready/idle combat pose, both feet clearly visible near a shared ground baseline at 92–94% of the image, centered in a square composition, with safe transparent margin around hair, cloth and complete weapon. Clean readable silhouette at small game size. Keep weapons rigid and straight from hilt/receiver through blade/barrel/tip, with hands gripping the actual handle, not the blade. Natural continuous hair strands, never layered plastic plates.
BACKGROUND MUST BE TRUE TRANSPARENCY, including between limbs. No background scene, floor, pedestal, throne, painted checkerboard, baked drop shadow, text, UI, border, lettering or watermark. No detached decoration, duplicate character, huge aura cloud, giant background summon or particle confetti. Tiny localized existing glows attached to armor/weapon may remain. The approved color palette and complexion must not drift. Do not bring back any older franchise design. Do not invent an additional weapon.

Character-specific invariants and pose:
Preserve the fair European mature man's silver naturally curly hair, amber eyes and stern angular face, gold-trimmed black high-collar robe, large amber circular collar gem and metal ring on fingers. Keep complexion fair under neutral light with restrained warm gold rim light, not uniformly brown. One open hand forward in a calm gravitational casting pose, other near waist. Complete black-and-gold robe hem and dark formal boots. No giant hand foreshortening, floating stones, headband, glyph pupils or scene.
Framing: entire character with hair, boots and all cloth/weapon tips strictly within central 88% of square canvas, transparent margins all around.
